An_approved_requirement_is_ver.description: An approved requirement is verified by a test

association.description: A plain connection between two elements, as on a diagram; not followed for traceability.
association.label: association

depends_on.description: The source needs the target: if the target changes, the source may have to change.
depends_on.label: depends on

implements.description: The source realises the target, for example a decision that meets a requirement.
implements.label: implements

mitigates.description: The source reduces the target risk.
mitigates.label: mitigates

refines.description: The source details the target: a more concrete statement of the same need.
refines.label: refines

relates_to.description: A loose association for orientation only; not followed for traceability.
relates_to.label: relates to

trace.description: General traceability from the source to the target, when no more specific type fits.
trace.label: trace

approved.description: Agreed by the people who decide; work may start.
approved.label: Approved

deprecated.description: Was valid, no longer is; kept for the record.
deprecated.label: Deprecated

rejected.description: Considered and turned down; kept for the record.
rejected.label: Rejected

validated.description: Checked to be right, for example reviewed or tested, but not yet delivered.
validated.label: Validated

ADR.description: Architecture decision: a choice made, the options considered and why. Usually implements requirements.
ADR.label: ADR

ASSET.description: Something the system uses or produces (data, device, document) that requirements refer to.
ASSET.label: ASSET

B-REQ.description: Business requirement: a goal of the organisation that pays for the product. User requirements refine it.
B-REQ.label: B-REQ

CONSTRAINT.description: A limit the solution must respect (law, policy, budget, existing systems), not chosen by the project.
CONSTRAINT.label: CONSTRAINT

DOC.description: A document outside the model that elements refer to.
DOC.label: DOC

FEAT.description: Feature: a coherent piece of product functionality that delivers user requirements.
FEAT.label: FEAT

ISSUE.description: An open problem or question found during the work, to be resolved.
ISSUE.label: ISSUE

NAMESPACE.description: Grouping element that gives a name to a part of the system; carries no requirement itself.
NAMESPACE.label: NAMESPACE

REQ.description: System requirement: one behaviour or quality the product must have, specific enough to test.
REQ.label: REQ

RISK.description: Something that may go wrong, with its severity and likelihood. Decisions mitigate it.
RISK.label: RISK

TEMPORAL-ADR.description: A decision meant to hold only for a while; its notes say when it is reviewed.
TEMPORAL-ADR.label: TEMPORAL-ADR

TEST-E2E.description: End-to-end test: checks a requirement through the whole system as a user would.
TEST-E2E.label: TEST-E2E

TEST-INT.description: Integration test: checks a requirement across two or more components.
TEST-INT.label: TEST-INT

U-REQ.description: User requirement: what a user needs to do, in the user's words. Features refine it.
U-REQ.label: U-REQ
